recorded_note: UTC date of the timestamps of the events next to these lines in the full stream.
source: Lines copied with no change from the stream of the specialist of one ticket of a delegate run. These events have no timestamp field, so each file holds only a part of a stream. A test puts a part after the timed events of a recorded stream in tests/fixtures/claude-code.

heartbeats.jsonl.how: four tool_progress events with "heartbeat": true, which the harness wrote each 30 seconds while a Bash command ran in the foreground

thinking.jsonl.how: two system events with the subtype thinking_tokens, which the harness wrote while the model thought
